```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse=TRUE, comment="#>")
library(nlrFlow)
```

`nlme::gnls` can model nonlinear parameters as functions of qualitative factors while simultaneously representing variance functions and within-group correlation.

```{r eval=FALSE}
a <- nl_data("agronomy_growth")
start <- c(18, 2, 1, 0.09, -0.005, 0.01, 52)
nl_fit(biomass_Mg_ha~Asym/(1+exp(-k*(day-xmid))),a,start=start,engine="gnls",params=list(Asym~cultivar,k~cultivar,xmid~1))
nl_capabilities()
nl_doctor()
```
